title: tool registry
description: contracts/tool.json: the tools that take part in the handoff convention, identical in every repository that follows it. tools/handoff.py tells which tool a repository root is by the markers (every marker path exists under the root), finds a peer through HANDOFF_<ID>_DIR (ID in upper case), --peer-dir ID=DIR or a sibling folder holding all of the peer's markers (never by folder name), checks packet from and to against the ids, finds built binaries (the env override, $CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release, the dirs under the tool's root, PATH) and lists stages through the providers. shared names the files that `handoff.py sync` copies byte for byte. A third tool joins by adding one entry to tools and syncing.

contract.description: The newest frames contract the registered tools speak.

id.description: Lower case, no hyphen, so packet ids can be split; also the ID of HANDOFF_<ID>_DIR.

markers.description: Relative POSIX paths that all exist in the tool's repository root and together exist in no other registered tool's root.

env.description: Environment variable holding the program path, or null.

dirs.description: Build folders relative to the tool's root, searched after $CARGO_TARGET_DIR/release.

prefix.description: Fixed words after the program; the manifest command is the program plus prefix.

list_args.description: Appended to the command to list the stages.

adapter.description: native: the output is a stage manifest; vfx-list: a bare array of vfx effect entries that handoff.py wraps.

shared.description: Relative POSIX paths or fnmatch patterns of the files `handoff.py sync` copies.
